purpose: Standing, on-your-mark crouch, set and launch sprite atlases

assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent sprint-game animation atlas.
Reference image: character identity, clothing, body proportions, rendering style ONLY. Create a NEW sprite sheet of the same athletic adult male player, tan skin, short dark hair, forest green singlet and dark forest green shorts, ivory sprint spikes. photorealistic high fidelity sports game sprite, realistic anatomy and muscles, natural lighting matching the reference.
Output exactly EIGHT full-body sprites in a strict FOUR columns by TWO rows regular grid, read left to right then top to bottom. Wide 2:1 canvas, equal square cells, even generous transparent gutters. True transparent alpha background. Each cell contains ONLY ONE instance of this SAME character.
Fixed orthographic SIDE view, all athletes face and move RIGHT. Keep camera, physical body scale, light, clothing and character identity EXACTLY constant across all 8 cells. Standing height approximately 78% of cell height. Hands and shoe contacts share a common imaginary horizontal ground baseline at 90% down each cell. Crouching characters must be naturally SHORTER in the cell at the SAME physical scale; do NOT enlarge crouches to fill each tile. Leave ample clearance for forward arms, back foot, head and shoes; no cropping, no overlap.
Eight consecutive natural sprint-start poses:
0: fully upright relaxed standing side profile, arms relaxed, feet ready.
1: hinge forward at hips, bend both knees, arms reaching down, beginning to lower.
2: lower further, front foot planted, rear knee near the ground, one hand approaching ground.
3: classic low ON YOUR MARK crouching sprint start, both hands touching ground in front, front leg bent, back knee down, head aligned with spine.
4: settle into a compact low crouch with both hands grounded, correct human joints and balanced weight.
5: SET pose, hips rise, rear knee lifts off ground, both hands still on ground, head low and forward.
6: explosive push-off at the gun, hands leave ground, body leaning forward, back leg extends, front knee drives forward.
7: first low forward acceleration stride, torso beginning to rise toward the reference running style, clean plausible foot contacts.
Avoid ANY environment, stadium, track, grass, floor plane, blocks, cast shadows, labels, captions, frame numbers, grid lines, watermarks, extra people, duplicate limbs, wrong-facing figures, mirrored anatomy, kneeling prayer poses or generic squats. Preserve transparent negative space and crisp uncropped silhouettes.

backgroundExtraction.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit ONLY the background of this supplied finished 8-frame 4x2 sprite atlas. Remove the entire off-white background, its soft gray shadows and contact shadow halos, replacing them with genuine fully TRANSPARENT alpha. Keep ALL eight voxel athletes exactly as they are: same poses, exact pixel placement, 4x2 grid, body scale, faces, clothes, shoes and crisp voxel edges. Do not redraw, crop, rearrange, resize, add text, or change anatomy. Transparency must exist between arms, legs, around fingers and throughout the empty canvas. Output a PNG with true alpha, no solid white/black/checkerboard matte.
